loadingNeed.basis: 4 truck loading bays for 5,903 m² of floor. The Parking By-law calls this size Class B, its mid-size bay: 10.2 × 3.4 m with 3.8 m clearance (Class C is the 23.1 m bay for the largest trucks). The count uses row 5.2.5 as the similar use: data centres are not listed, so the Director of Planning decides (s. 5.1.4). Each bay is reached by a 6.1 m aisle (s. 5.4.1). If the City reads a data centre as a storage warehouse, 2 Class C spaces (23.1 × 3.6 m, 14.0 m aisle) would also be needed.

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer.
